newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anscor to raise capital to 4 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Anscor to raise capital to 4 bln pesos.

text.p: Holding concern A Soriano Corp (Anscor) said it plans to expand its authorised capital stock to four billion pesos from 2.45 billion pesos.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Thursday, Anscor said the proposal will be submitted for approval to stockholders on April 16, 1997.

The meeting will also seek approval for the removal of pre-emptive rights in the issuance of shares in the offering of convertible notes, bonds and other securitries convertible into shares, the company said.
